Not a direct data value; equals (BonusDamage + ADRatio x bonus AD) x MaxIncrease=3, i.e. the per-bullet minimum tripled by the crit multiplier cap; AkshanR#MaxDamagePerBullet reads these same rows via DamagePerBulletWithCrit x MaxIncrease.

values.meaning: Minimum Charged Physical Damage (all bullets, no crit/missing-hp)
values.binNote: Not a single bin row; equals BonusDamage x NumberOfBullets plus ADRatio x AD x NumberOfBullets, i.e. NumberOfBullets copies of the minimum per-bullet damage.

values.meaning: Damage to target on 67% missing hp (all bullets, tripled)
values.binNote: Wiki labels this as damage at '67% missing hp' but the numbers are exactly 3x the r_5 total (i.e. the fully-scaled maximum from AkshanR.MaxIncrease=3), not the true value at 67% missing health under the stated 2%-per-1% formula (which would give a 2.34x multiplier, not 3x); recorded as the wiki states it.

values.meaning: Critical damage scaling factor added to bullet damage per point of crit chance
values.binNote: CritDamageMod (0.3) is multiplied by critChance and by (critDamage - 1) per the bin calculation; wiki quotes the resulting 0-30% range at 100% crit chance and default crit damage.

values.meaning: Cooldown applied if the channel is cancelled
Minimum time before the recast becomes available during the channel

mechanics.claim: Akshan channels for 2.5 seconds, gradually storing bullets, before the recast fires them; the recast happens automatically after the channel ends.
The ability can be recast early, 0.5 seconds into the channel, or fires automatically once the channel completes.
mechanics.quote: can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically afterwards

mechanics.claim: If the channel is cancelled (before any bullets fire), the ability goes on a flat 5-second cooldown instead of its normal cooldown.
mechanics.quote: is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if the channel is cancelled

mechanics.claim: Bullet damage scales up with the target's missing health at 2% bonus damage per 1% missing health, capped at 100% missing health (a 200% increase).
mechanics.quote: 2% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health

mechanics.claim: Each bullet applies life steal to Akshan and executes (instantly kills) minions.
mechanics.quote: Each bullet's damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not prevent the lock-on/channel and only blocks a single bullet, not the whole volley.
mechanics.quote: will not prevent the lock-on and will only block a single bullet

mechanics.claim: The channel (and thus the whole cast) is cancelled if the target becomes untargetable or dies during the channel.
mechanics.quote: will cancel if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} or {{tip|death|dies}} during the channel

mechanics.claim: Damage is calculated dynamically off Akshan's current stats (AD, crit) rather than locked in at cast time.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.

mechanics.claim: During the channel, Q and W cannot be cast, but E remains usable.
The channel refreshes the duration of the passive's Dirty Fighting stacks on the target every 0.25 seconds.
mechanics.quote: ''Comeuppance'' refreshes the duration of ''{{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}}'' stacks on the target every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
